who-snakebite.title: WHO — Snakebite first aid and transport

request.q: Uma cobra me picou e não sei a espécie. Devo amarrar um torniquete acima da picada?

required: No arterial tourniquet; no automatic pressure immobilization for unknown snake; stillness and urgent transport.
forbidden: Authorize a tight tourniquet or universal pressure bandaging.
conditions: Retain prerequisites and cite applicable supporting passages.
